svg.title: Apigee or F5 XC? A scenario decision tree
svg.desc: Start from what you are exposing and to whom; the answer usually falls out of one sentence
svg.text: Apigee or F5 XC? A scenario decision tree
Start from what you are exposing and to whom; the answer usually falls out of one sentence
XC has no portal, no products, no
secure delivery + WAF in front of
Anycast VIP + TLS + WAF at the edge
CE tunnels reach backends: zero public IPs
Same policy across GCP / AWS / DC
Minutes to publish, no portal needed
Apigee cannot reach into a VPC or
TCP load balancers, not only HTTP
gRPC rides HTTP/2: handled at L7
Apigee speaks HTTP APIs only and
e.g. monetized partner API on GKE
XC: VIP, WAF, DDoS at the edge
↓ private origins via CE / private connect
backends must stay dark · you span clouds ·
WAF/DDoS is the requirement · non-HTTP or
mesh) · no WAF, portal or multi-cloud need —
added platforms are added cost and ops
Rule of thumb: “product”, “portal”, “quota tier”, “monetize” → Apigee · “private”, “WAF”, “multi-cloud”, “no public IP” → F5 XC
Choose by the problem, not the shared verbs: product governance (Apigee) vs delivery and security (F5 XC).
